# find_cycles_in_sgraph { #mofography.analyze.find_cycles_in_sgraph }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> cycle_basis rings with isomorphism expansion; prefer compute_aromatic_cycles for MOFs. Use `compute_aromatic_cycles` instead.

```python
analyze.find_cycles_in_sgraph(sgraph, default_ring_sizes=[5, 6, 7, 8, 9])
```

List chordless cycles in a bond graph, filtered by size and expanded by subgraph isomorphism.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name               | Type   | Description                               | Default           |
|--------------------|--------|-------------------------------------------|-------------------|
| sgraph             |        | The graph that you want to find cycles in | _required_        |
| default_ring_sizes |        | The ring sizes you want to look for       | `[5, 6, 7, 8, 9]` |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                         |
|--------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | A list of lists of nodes that are in the same ring. |
